items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: page.tsx: Breadcrumb 'Contracts' link to /contracts > BreadcrumbPage {c.id} (HD-2026-0187). Header shows vendor h1, 'Expiring soon' Badge, id in subtitle; facts strip has exactly 4 (Current value, Term, Time remaining, Contract owner).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Header has only an outline 'Export PDF' button; no primary action in the header (Start renewal review is in the Renewal card), no edit/terminate, no overflow menu.

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: contacts-card.tsx: name, p.role, a href mailto:, a href tel:, Badge 'Primary' (visible in screenshot for Jonas Verhoeven).

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: milestones-card.tsx has due date, status badge, amount with text-right tabular-nums and money(); but rows render c.milestones in data order with no sorting, paid ones not moved last, so overdue/due-soon are not first.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: Status badges read Paid/Invoiced/Upcoming; only a faint 'milestone date passed' note for late invoiced rows. No 'Overdue' or 'Due in N days' label for upcoming/due-soon items.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: renewal-card.tsx: 'Notice deadline 31 Dec 2026 / 56 days left to give notice'; 'Current term ends 31 Mar 2027'; facts strip 'Time remaining 146 days'.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: No empty, loading, skeleton, error or retry code in any component (grep found none); all sections are static maps.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: No terminate action or confirmation dialog exists in the route.

tells: initials-avatar-non-person is not present (avatars are for people)
card-in-card (amber/muted notice box inside the Renewal card)

notes: Clean, restrained visual style, no gradients, glass or emoji. The audit JSON was not opened. Main gaps are behavioural: no primary header action or terminate flow, no loading/empty/error states, milestones unsorted with no Overdue or Due-in-N-days text.
